name: WatershedShift public data

files.description: GEFSv12 control-member precipitation forecast, 00Z Monday cycles, averaged over each reservoir's upstream box: lead hours (0,168] and (168,384]. source = reforecast (retrospective, not issued in real time) or operational (published_utc_max = latest S3 Last-Modified of the 64 files used).
attribution: NOAA GEFSv12 reforecast (Guan et al. 2022, Monthly Weather Review, doi:10.1175/MWR-D-21-0245.1), via the NOAA Open Data Dissemination program on AWS. Retrospective forecasts, not issued in real time. Derived by WatershedShift; no NOAA endorsement is implied.

NOAA NCEP Global Ensemble Forecast System version 12 (GEFSv12), via the NOAA Open Data Dissemination program on AWS. Basin aggregates are derived by WatershedShift and are not unaltered NOAA data; no NOAA endorsement is implied.

files.description: NASA POWER daily weather (PRECTOTCORR, T2M, RH2M; LST) at each dam (dam_point) and averaged over POWER grid-cell centres inside the upstream box (upstream_box_mean). Implausible values set to missing.
attribution: The data was obtained from the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) Langley Research Center (LaRC) Prediction of Worldwide Energy Resources (POWER) Project funded through the NASA Earth Science Directorate Applied Science Program.

files.description: Cleaned CDEC daily end-of-day reservoir storage (sensor 15), 2001-01-01 to 2026-11-20. storage_pct uses the capacity in force on each date (data/capacity_history.csv). Out-of-range values and unreviewed one-day spikes are blank, never interpolated. cdec_flag: e = estimated, r = revised. 2026 values are provisional.
attribution: Data from the California Data Exchange Center (CDEC), California Department of Water Resources (https://cdec.water.ca.gov). Reservoir records relayed by CDEC originate with the reservoir operators (US Bureau of Reclamation, California DWR, Merced Irrigation District and the Don Pedro operators). Values are provisional and subject to revision; no endorsement by DWR or the operators is implied.

files.description: Cleaned CDEC daily snow water content (sensor 82, adjusted), inches. 2001-2025: all 51 candidate pillows; 2026: the core pillows used by the models. Missing stays missing; small negatives (>= -0.5 in) set to 0.
attribution: Data from the California Data Exchange Center (CDEC), California Department of Water Resources (https://cdec.water.ca.gov). Reservoir records relayed by CDEC originate with the reservoir operators (US Bureau of Reclamation, California DWR, Merced Irrigation District and the Don Pedro operators). Values are provisional and subject to revision; no endorsement by DWR or the operators is implied.
